subject: CartoPulse renewal: committed ladder & soft-cap request
messages:
From: Alyssa Bennett <alyssa@cartopulse.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: daniel.ruiz@cartopulse.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation + proposed commit ladder for Q4

Hi Chloe / Karthik,

Quick context: our current contract ends 2027-10-15. Over the last 6 months we’ve seen steady growth in peak traffic (particularly weekends) and we hit throttling thresholds twice in July during a promotional window. We want to lock in a renewal before Oct so procurement can approve PO and avoid a gap.

High-level ask: Can Redwood support a stepped committed monthly token ladder rather than a single flat commit? We’d like to propose: 3M tokens/month for Oct-Nov, 5M for Dec-Feb (holiday ramp), then 7M sustained starting Mar 2028. We also need a soft-cap / short burst pocket (500k tokens) for marketing spikes and a smoother graceband on soft throttles.

I attached our usage/export and a draft renewal sheet. Can we get preliminary pricing and whether you’d approve a temporary higher burst window during the holiday ramp?

Next steps from us: procurement contact will need consolidated SOW and a sample invoice timeline.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Bennett
Head of Product
CartoPulse
Attachments: CartoPulse_Renewal_Draft_2027-08-24.pdf
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Bennett <alyssa@cartopulse.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + proposed commit ladder for Q4

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear summary and the file. I reviewed the export; the weekend spikes are predictable (campaign-driven) which makes a stepped ladder a good fit.

What we can do now:
- Propose a tiered commit structure (we’ll send price bands) that matches your suggested ramp.
- Offer a 500k token burst pocket for the Q4 holiday window (one-time, non-rolling) and a 48-hour elevated graceband before soft throttle triggers.
- Provide a draft SOW and invoice timing so procurement has something to review.

Requests from our side:
1) Can you share the last 3 months of 5-minute resolution peak metrics (CSV) so we can size KV cache and predicted latency changes?
2) Are you open to a 12-month minimum term with quarterly volume checkpoints? That structure enables better pricing on the March sustained level.

Proposed immediate next step: 30-minute call next week to walk pricing bands + ops runbook. I’m free Tue 31 Aug 10:00–12:00 PDT or Wed 1 Sep 14:00–16:00 PDT.

I’ve looped Marissa (CS) to outline the migration runbook and Karthik (Sales) for pricing.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_Capacity_Ladder.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: internal: pricing bands & margin view for CartoPulse (CP-2027-0411)

Team — skimming Alyssa's proposal. Thoughts / constraints from pricing and finance:

- We can support the ladder (3M -> 5M -> 7M) with stepped unit price reductions at each band. Recommend 4 pricing bands: 0–2.5M, 2.5–4.5M, 4.5–6.5M, 6.5M+.
- To protect margin, attach a soft-throttle policy: after burst pocket consumption we apply a 60% throttle for up to 2 hours then release to baseline. That’s more lenient than our default.
- For Q4 holiday window we can provide the 500k burst at list-rate credits (one-time) if procurement commits to the ladder and minimum term.

Ask Finance: can you model a 12-month term where we front-load capacity discounts starting month 4 so CartoPulse sees immediate savings in the holiday window?

I’ll draft an initial quote and the delta from their current contract. Chloe — if you want, I’ll run two scenarios (12-month with ladder; 24-month commitment with steeper discounts).

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Bennett <alyssa@cartopulse.com>, daniel.ruiz@cartopulse.com
Cc: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Ops kickoff & migration runbook (CartoPulse renewal)

Hi Alyssa / Daniel — looping the ops side ahead of the renewal call. A few notes from CS perspective:

- Runbook: we’ll execute a staged capacity switch to the new commit with pre-warm of KV caches (to avoid latency blips). See runbook attached.
- Change window: prefer a low-impact window (Sun 10–14:00 PDT) for the first staged uplift; we’ll monitor traces and token consumption in real time.
- Post-migration rollback: we’ll hold a 24-hour rollback window and an SLA exception to avoid false positives on throttling during initial ramp.

Please confirm the preferred change window. I’ll book the runbook review meeting once we settle pricing.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Runbook_Migration.md
From: Alyssa Bennett <alyssa@cartopulse.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: daniel.ruiz@cartopulse.com, procurement@cartopulse.com
Date: Fri, 02 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + proposed commit ladder for Q4

Thanks — that all sounds reasonable. Procurement (procurement@cartopulse.com) needs the finalized SOW and a DocuSign-ready version of the quote and terms. We’re comfortable with a 12-month minimum term tied to quarterly checkpoints.

For the change window we’ll target Sun Sep 12 10:00–14:00 PDT for the first staged uplift. Please include a short SLA exception clause for the first 48 hours and the confirmed one-time 500k burst pocket in the DocuSign.

If you can send a draft SOW + quote by EOD Mon Sep 6, procurement can issue a PO the following week.

Best,
Alyssa
